fluff.overview:
Every Concordat world maintains infantry formations as the first line of planetary defense, drawn from a population whose fierce independence and hatred of foreign aggression run deep. Jump platoons provide the vertical mobility that Taurian garrison commanders prize for defending the rough terrain and broken ground found on many Concordat border worlds. Their ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives them a tactical advantage over standard foot infantry.

Support troops carry man-portable flamers that project streams of burning chemicals over several hundred square meters, providing devastating area-effect capability against infantry and structures at the cost of short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank.
